content:
alex.kim: Heads up — planning the private deployment switch for tenant 'TitanRetail-PRD' into our on-prem Dedicated pool this Thursday night. Requesting approval for the change window and the version pin.

sana.patel: thanks. what's the proposed window? and which image/tag are we pinning to?

alex.kim: Proposed: Thu 03/19 22:00 - 23:30 UTC (90m). Pin to infra image `model-server:v3.2.1-rc4` and runtime config `quant-profile: q8_2` to match perf tests.

marco.ruiz: 90m seems fine. Can we do a stepped canary: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 5–10m soak between steps?

alex.kim: Yes — plan is 5/25/60/100 with health checks at each step. If any step fails, automated rollback to `model-server:v3.2.0` (current prod) will kick.

eli-oncall: What's our rollback trigger concretely? Need SLO-safe numbers for the change window doc.

alex.kim: Rollback triggers:
```
- 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained over 2m
- p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline for 3m
- token cost regression > 15% observed in telemetry
- manual abort by oncall or product owner
```
If any of these fire during a canary step, deploy-bot will pause and notify oncall for manual confirm.

sana.patel: Add one more: autoretry-induced error spike (error budget burn > 1% over 5m). Also document the expected degradation pattern for a DB failover.

marco.ruiz: Agree. Also we need the rollback playbook link in the thread: https://intranet.redwood/ops/playbooks/rollback-dedicated.md

alex.kim: Added. Also adding a preflight checklist:
- infra smoke test job (image pull + start) ✅
- small query suite against pinned model ✅
- certificate sync with customer VPC ✅
- routes pinned in traffic-router config ✅
- alert thresholds updated in PagerDuty runbook ✅

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: `tenant-edge-switch: TitanRetail-PRD -> onprem-dedicated (v3.2.1-rc4)` at 2026-03-19T22:00:00Z. Canary plan: [5,25,60,100]. Notifications: #eng-releases, @eli-oncall.

eli-oncall: I can be on-call for the window. Will monitor dashboards and be ready to rollback.

sana.patel: Approve from product/security side, pending final signoff on cert sync from network (infra-team). @marco.ruiz can you confirm certs?

marco.ruiz: Confirmed — certs are synced to customer VPC, TTL validated.

alex.kim: Final ask: create an audit entry and link customer-facing release notes to the ticket. I'll attach the canary logs and perf baselines post-deploy.

sana.patel: :thumbsup: Approving schedule and pin. Move to green.

eli-oncall: I will be online during the window. If anything looks off, I'll hit rollback and post a short postmortem.

alex.kim: Thanks all. Proceeding to run preflight tomorrow at 08:00 UTC and will post results here.

deploy-bot: Preflight job queued: `tenant-edge-preflight: TitanRetail-PRD` scheduled for 2026-03-18T08:00:00Z. Results will be posted to this thread.
